{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]|the [[Carrier (speedball)|speedball position]] or [[Troop carrier/Legends|troop carriers]]}}
[[File:EnduranceClassFleetCarrier-EGTW.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Endurance'' class had an extensively reworked [[Hull/Legends|hull]] from its ''Nebula''-class origin.]]
A '''carrier''' was a type of military [[Starship/Legends|starship]] specifically designed to focus on the transportation of small starships. They were generally considered separate from the [[Warship/Legends|warship]], any vessel honed to be a weapons platform on its own.<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
The term ''carrier'' can be divided into two main types: dedicated carriers, generally with few weapons and weak shielding,<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Warship/Legends|warships]], which also had a substantial capacity for carrying [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

==History==
[[File:BattleofFondor.jpg|thumb|170px|Vong carriers and [[Hapan]] [[Hapan Battle Dragon|Battle Dragons]] are caught in a blast from [[Centerpoint Station]].]]

In the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] era, the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] was used as a dual [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]]/carrier. By contrast, the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] was assigned to strictly a destroyer role, as it had a small complement of fighters relative to its size.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> This tradition of using similar [[Hull/Legends|hull]] design, but with a separate carrier and destroyer version, was carried on in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Class Modernization Program]], with the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]] sharing the same hull as the [[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Nebula''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>

Due to the communication and coordination capabilities of carriers, they were often used as command ships. The New Republic's [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]] flagship during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] was an ''Endurance''-class carrier. In contrast, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used different [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]] for command and carrier purposes, respectively.<ref name="SOTGSE">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

[[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] and [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]] regularly had a small complement of fighters.<ref name="ISB" /> Additionally, some other ships, such as [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvettes]], could be modified to carry a handful of fighters.<ref name="X:WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref><ref name="DC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref> [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] did not have an internal hangar, so an exterior rack was added for up to five TIEs on reconnaissance or courier duties.<ref name="ISB" />

The carrier concept was not limited to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], Empire, and New Republic, as at least the [[Ssi-ruu]]k<ref name="TEGTVAV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="TNJOS">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> had their own carrier analogs.

==Known dedicated carrier designs==
===[[A-vek Iiluunu]]===
A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] carrier type, 800 meters long on average.

===[[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]===
A type of troop carrier used during the Clone Wars.

[[File:Defender_Carrier.jpg|thumb|200px|The ''Defender''-class carrier]]

===[[Defender-class assault carrier|''Defender''-class assault carrier]]===
The 700-meter ''Defender'' class was originally developed for the [[Defender (ship-design program)|Defender program]] in the early New Republic, but was taken up by the New Class Modernization Program and improved upon. The design also became an inspiration for the [[Majestic-class heavy cruiser|''Majestic''-class heavy cruiser]], using its hull as basis.

===[[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]]===
Based on the ''Nebula''-class Star Destroyer hull, the 1,040-meter ''Endurance'' class carried a large complement of fighters.

===[[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]]===
A 500-meter Imperial support carrier design, it could carry up to 72 starfighters, like the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].

[[File:Hininbirg.png|thumb|200px|A Ton-Falk Escort Carrier]]

===[[Galactic-class battle carrier|''Galactic''-class battle carrier]]===
The 1,600-meter ''Galactic'' class was based on earlier [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] designs, but with a larger mass, and extensive carrier facilities. It held several squadrons of fighters.

===[[Imperial escort carrier (storm commando)|Imperial escort carrier]]===
This escort carrier design was used exclusively by the [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In addition to a large, central hangar, the craft had several heavy cannons lining its hull.

===''[[Kalla's Stanchion]]''===
This vessel resembled an oversized [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] and had several hangars lining its hull.

===[[Mon Calamari heavy carrier]]===
This was a heavy warship class built by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in the lead-up to the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

[[File:QuasarFireCarrier-SWR.png|thumb|200px|''Quasar Fire''-class modified bulk cruiser]]

===[[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser]]===
This bulk cruiser design was retrofitted to serve as a dedicated fighter carrier.

===[[Sh'ner-class planetary assault carrier|''Sh'ner''-class planetary assault carrier]]===
This 750-meter carrier was used by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] and could store landing craft in its 12 launching bays.

===Starfighter carrier===
The Galactic Empire employed some Super Star Destroyers as dedicated fighter carriers.

==Dual-role carrier designs==
===''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer===
{{Main|Providence-class carrier/destroyer}}
The 1,088-meter ''Providence'' class had an extensive hangar system lining its sides. On modified ships like the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], this was enlarged even further.

===''Venator''-class Star Destroyer===
{{Main|Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends}}
The 1,137-meter ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer served the dual purpose of a fighting ship and a carrier, being capable of holding 420 small Republic starfighters inside the dorsal hangar bays that ran along much of the ship's length.

===''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer===
{{Main|Secutor-class Star Destroyer/Legends}}
The 2,200-meter ''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer served the dual purpose of a fighting ship and a carrier. Its size would have normally qualified it as a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|Battlecruiser]] under the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]], but its relative lack of firepower as well as the aforementioned carrier capabilities placed it in the Star Destroyer designation.
